Precondition: A photo with one or two people open in the editor
Action:
1. Tap Edit › 「Cutout」
2. Tap 「Auto」
3. Tap 「Cutout」
Expected Result: The Cutout room opens with the cut-out people on the canvas, an edit (pencil) button on the canvas, tabs 「Background」 and 「Stroke」 with 「Background」 selected, category chips starting with 「Solid」 and the item row below.

Precondition:
1. In the Cutout room just entered (a person photo, 「Auto」 selection, 「Cutout」 tapped)
2. No step made yet
Action: Look at the bottom bar
Expected Result:
Five buttons from left to right: ✕, Reset, Undo, Redo, ✓
Reset, Undo and Redo are grey (disabled)
✕ and ✓ are enabled

Precondition:
1. In the Cutout room just entered (a person photo, 「Auto」 selection, 「Cutout」 tapped)
2. No step made yet
Action:
1. Tap Reset
2. Tap Undo
3. Tap Redo
Expected Result: Nothing happens: canvas and panel unchanged, the three buttons stay grey.

1. In the Cutout room just entered (a person photo, 「Auto」 selection, 「Cutout」 tapped)
2. No step made yet
Action: Tap 「White」 in the 「Solid」 item row

The background turns white
Reset and Undo are enabled
Redo stays disabled

In the Cutout room, 「Solid」 chip (two steps):
1. Tap 「White」
2. Tap 「Black」
Action: Tap Undo

The background is white again
Reset, Undo and Redo are all enabled

In the Cutout room, 「Solid」 chip (two steps):
